Interaction effect = (wp - wb) x (rp_sector - rb_sector): consumers +12 bp, technology +15 bp, financials the remainder (about +33 bp, large underweight where selection was bad); total ~60 bp
Summary table by sector and effect; sums to ~178-180 bp = excess return
Interpretation: better allocators than stock pickers; poor selection in financials; one month too short to act on

title: PE Fund Performance Metrics: TVPI vs. MOIC vs. DPI and Gross vs. Net IRR
channel: Mergers & Inquisitions / Breaking Into Wall Street
inputs: Annual fund cash flows: invested capital per portfolio company, realizations, unrealized values
Fund terms: 2% management fee on commitments in investment period then 1.5% on remaining cost; 20% carry
output: Excel schedule of gross MOIC/IRR, management fees, realized and accrued carry, net value, NAV, TVPI, DPI, RVPI, net IRR with interpretation (fund 'solid but not spectacular', DPI 2x acceptable in year 6 of 10)

steps.step: Before metrics, establish fund life-cycle stage, strategy and valuation assumptions
Gross MOIC (~1.9x) = (realized + unrealized) / invested; gross IRR on gross cash flows
Management fees: 2% of commitments in investment period, then 1.5% of remaining cost basis (~$4.7bn) in year 6
Net value = gross value - realized and accrued carry; TVPI = net value / called capital (investments + fees)
Net IRR on net cash flows (always below gross); DPI = (realizations - distributed carry) / called capital
Interpretation: unknown valuation assumptions; DPI low but year 6 of 10; gross-net gap ~6-7 points normal; net IRR above long-run S&P but not by much
Allocate management fees to companies by time-weighted cost-basis share (~$62-63m to the exited company)
Carry per realized company = 20% x (realizations - investment - allocated fees), MIN(0,...) so losses do not create negative carry; accrued carry on unrealized pool, net of carry already paid
Build gross and net cash-flow rows; NAV = unrealized value - accrued carry; compute MOIC, IRR, TVPI, DPI, RVPI = TVPI - DPI
Complications: challenge GP marks (cut an 8-9x revenue multiple to 7-8x vs public comps), hurdle/catch-up waterfalls, recycling, clawbacks

checks: Net IRR < gross IRR once fees exist
Carry sign/MIN(0) guard for losses
RVPI = TVPI - DPI identity
Sanity-check GP valuation multiples against public comps
judgment: Whether a low DPI is a red flag given fund age

Customer-type review: individuals vs businesses, intercompany/owner receivables, foreign AR without credit insurance, government AR -> ineligible
BBC mechanics: total AR 18m -> less >90, contras, concentrations, cross-aged, foreign, government, affiliate; add back approved >90 credits (e.g. named obligors allowed to 120 days)
Apply advance rate (typically 80%) -> ~8m AR availability; inventory: total less ineligible (WIP) x ~50% advance, capped relative to AR
Maximum loan amount = lesser of collateral availability and commitment ($2m); subtract outstanding balance -> remaining availability or required paydown
